graphics.caption: Folio 0017 Figure 1
graphics.title: Proposition 4: Intersecting chords do not bisect each other
graphics.description: Circle ABCD with chords AC and BD not passing through the centre cutting at E and showing they do not bisect each other.
graphics.text_reference: Let ABCD be a circle, and in it let the two straight lines AC, BD, which are not through the centre, cut one another at E; I say that they do not bisect one another...
